name: std::back_inserter
intro: back_inserter is a convenience function template that constructs a std::back_insert_iterator for the container c with the type deduced from the type of the argument.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
c

 -

 container that supports a push_back operation

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A std::back_insert_iterator which can be used to add elements to the end of the container c.

sections.title: Possible implementation

summary: back_inserter is a convenience function template that constructs a std::back_insert_iterator for the container c with the type deduced from the type of the argument.
